description: You Decide guardrails: ask before network sends and irreversible commands, block secrets written to files, re-inject the state file after a compaction or /clear.

hooks.command: for p in python3 "py -3" python; do $p -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; done; exit 0
for p in python3 "py -3" python; do $p -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/state_context.py"; done; exit 0
